exercises.why: **списке** — спи́сок: list, register, roll (register or roll of paper consisting of an enumeration or compilation of a set of possible items); handwritten or handpainted copy (especially of a manuscript or a religious icon). Wiktionary: с- + писа́ть + -ок.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: опи́сывать — to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); вы́писать — to sign out; припи́сывать — to add (by writing).

exercises.q: This poem is attributed to him.
exercises.why: **приписывают** — припи́сывать (imperfective): to add (by writing); to attach, to register; to arrogate, to ascribe, to attribute, to impute. Wiktionary: приписа́ть + -ывать.
